description: Search the text of every saved quotation, ranked. Use this when the user wants language to quote rather than an authority to cite: each hit carries the passage, the authority it came from, and its pincite. Quote a phrase to require it verbatim. This searches only what the user chose to save; to search the full text of captured opinions and statutes, use search_library.

offset.description: Skip this many results; use the nextOffset from the previous call.

query.description: Language to find. Omit it to list every saved quotation instead.

name: search_quotes
title: Search saved quotations
